probes.label: one-function prepare merge, disposable target and candidate
probes.code:
(require 'seon.test-support)
(let [ctx (sci.ctx-store/get-ctx)
 context (my.program/supplied-context (assoc (seon.env/of ctx) :my.program/executing-ctx ctx))
 target (seon.cluster.agent/acquire-context! context nil {:seon.agent/isolate? true})
 target (assoc target :seon.agent/id "astra-test-run-cost")
 connection (:seon.db/connection target)
 store (:seon.store/store target)
 f 'seon.cluster.merge-test/astra-cost-callee
 t 'seon.cluster.merge-test/astra-cost-proof]
 (try
  (seon.test-support/transacted! connection
   [(seon.test-support/program-entity (seon.db/db connection) [:seon.fn/sym f]
     "(defn astra-cost-callee {:malli/schema [:=> [:cat] :int]} [] 1)")
    (seon.test-support/program-entity (seon.db/db connection) [:seon.test/sym t]
     "(clojure.test/deftest astra-cost-proof (clojure.test/is (= 1 (astra-cost-callee))))")])
  (let [candidate (seon.cluster.agent/acquire-context! target nil {:seon.agent/isolate? true})
        c (:seon.db/connection candidate)]
   (try
    (seon.test-support/transacted! c (seon.test-support/replacement-tx (seon.db/db c) [:seon.fn/sym f]
      "(defn astra-cost-callee {:malli/schema [:=> [:cat] :int]} [] (inc 0))" {}))
    (let [m (seon.profile/measure (fn [] (seon.cluster.source/prepare-merge! target store (:seon.agent/branch candidate) #{t})))
          proposal (:seon.profile/value m)]
     (try
      (assoc (select-keys m [:seon.profile/ms :seon.profile/alloc-bytes :seon.profile/calls :seon.profile/reads])
             :result proposal
             :ranked (take 8 (:seon.profile/ranked-by-self m))
             :calls (select-keys (:seon.profile/called m) '[seon.sci.eval/copy-host-var seon.sci.eval/install-row! seon.db/transact-call]))
      (finally (when-let [branch (:seon.source/candidate proposal)]
                 (seon.cluster.registry/retire-branch! {:seon.store/store store :seon.store/branch branch})))))
    (finally (seon.cluster.agent/release-context! candidate))))
  (finally (seon.cluster.agent/release-context! target))))
